summary: Opposes cutting or limiting E‑Rate funding, arguing that reducing internet access for schools and libraries harms education and society.

claims.argument: Cutting or limiting E‑Rate funding would harm students and educators who rely on internet access for learning and development.
claims.evidence_quote: The idea of reducing or cutting access to the internet for schools and public libraries is, quite frankly, one of the most ridiculous things we've ever heard. Doing so will only cause harm to people
